wikipedia.title: DNA_photolyase_N-terminal_domain
wikipedia.extract: DNA photolyase, N-terminal is an evolutionary conserved protein domain. This domain binds a light harvesting chromophore that enhanced the spectrum of photolyase or cryptochrome light absorption, i.e. an antenna. It adopts the Rossmann fold.
